messages:
sam: Heads-up: multiple SCIM requests to Okta started getting 403/401 around 08:10 UTC. Provisioner logs show KMS decrypt access denied.

sam: Snippet:
```
2026-07-12T08:10:12Z provisioner req=xyz status=401 err="KMS Decrypt: AccessDenied"
2026-07-12T08:10:13Z provisioner req=xyz retry=1 status=403 err="token verification failed"
```

nina: I just applied an RBAC policy change to the provisioner role to tighten permissions (removed broad kms:* on legacy key). Could be related.

deploy-bot: iam/role-update applied by nina at 08:08 UTC :white_check_mark:

security-oncall: Collect CloudTrail KMS Decrypt events and IAM policy change. Need principal, API call details, and whether Decrypt returned AccessDenied vs NotFound. Tag incident sec-2026-07-12-kms-rbac.

ops: Quick mitigation: re-grant kms:Decrypt on the envelope key to the provisioner role, monitor for 5m, then craft a least-privilege policy.

nina: Reapplied scoped kms:Decrypt to provisioner at 08:14 UTC and limited to alias/redwood/provisioner.

sam: SCIM calls returned 200s after 08:15. Confirmed affected tenants synced.

security-oncall: Save CloudTrail and IAM ChangeLog lines. Postmortem items: add a pre-change checklist for RBAC edits that affect runtime decrypt; add automated policy-sanity guard that runs a dry-run against active secrets.

nina: Will open PR to add the guard and update runbook. Also will coordinate a quick notice to CS for tenants who saw transient deprovision attempts.

security-oncall: Closing thread; moving artifacts to incident page. :lock:
